label: Ṛgvedic textual horizon
range: Latter half of the second millennium BCE
note: Broad corpus horizon from Jamison–Brereton; not a dated birth, death, or individual hymn. Oral composition complicates finer dating.

label: Later Vedic reception
range: After the hymn tradition; absolute range not assigned here
note: Taittirīya Saṃhitā 7.5.5 already treats a hymn as Agastya’s; a date for this particular layer remains to be sourced.

label: Contemporary of Rāma and Daśaratha
range: Rāma’s exile; friendship with the preceding king
note: Internal synchronism only. Does not independently supply a BCE year.

label: Tretā-yuga linkage
note: Bhāgavata 9.10.51 puts Rāma’s reign in Tretā. Linking Agastya to it combines two texts; it is not an explicit birth date for Agastya.

label: Rāmāyaṇa formative period · Nagy synthesis
note: Broad scholarly model of epic formation; individual Agastya passages may have different histories. Earlier oral material and later growth are not excluded.

label: Past deeds in Yudhiṣṭhira’s narrative present
range: Earlier than Lomaśa’s account to the Pāṇḍavas
note: The pilgrimage story establishes earlier deeds, not a meeting or a dated death. In §104 Agastya has not returned from the south as of the narrator’s present.

label: Nahuṣa’s curse
note: The duration belongs to Nahuṣa’s serpent curse. It is not Agastya’s age and is not used as a calendar anchor.

label: Mahābhārata formative period · Nagy synthesis
note: Broad corpus formation, not the date of the war or the date of Agastya.

label: Bhāgavata · Holdrege’s dating
note: Numeric endpoints are visualization approximations to the source’s century wording. Applies to text, not narrated persons.

label: Bhāgavata · Ray’s older proposal
note: Historical alternative in the dating literature; not represented as equal to a current consensus or as Agastya’s lifetime.

label: Nacciṉārkkiṉiyar commentary witness
note: Dates this witness to the disciple tradition, not the origin of every Tamil Agastya tradition and not the life of Tolkāppiyar or Agastya.

label: Indus cultural-memory hypothesis · Mahadevan
range: Post-Indus migration interpretation; no individual lifespan
note: A modern interpretation of legends and undeciphered signs; no independently read Agastya inscription or secure absolute date is established.
